summary: Iteration 13: Validated 8 NEW Voice-Design ElevenLabs DJ voices + eleven_v3 TTS model end-to-end. Backend (18/18 pytest passed) confirms /api/elevenlabs/voices returns exactly the 8 new voice_ids in 4 vibe groups, and /api/bumpers/generate produces 200 + audio_url for every new voice across all 3 styles (energetic/smooth/announcer) using eleven_v3. Frontend Playwright confirms picker shows 8 new voices in 4 optgroups (Top 40/Chill Lofi/Rock / Metal/Accents), no old stock names (Adam/Rachel/Liam/Callum/George/etc.), create flow persists station, and DJ break fires POST with correct voice_id+voice_style and shows the bumper-banner with generated DJ text.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~1156 lines — modularization (routers/services) recommended but non-blocking.
voice_style still validated only by dict.get fallback — invalid styles silently fall back to 'energetic'. Consider Pydantic Literal['energetic','smooth','announcer'] at API boundary.
Audio is returned inline as base64 data URL (~tens of KB per bumper) — acceptable for demo but a streaming/CDN URL would scale better.
Feed.fm skip endpoint can return success=false on rapid skips; UI already handles via toast, but Player relies on user-pace skipping for DJ break testing — fine in real use.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_v3_UI_Station (UI flow) and TEST_v3_station (pytest). All removed at end of run.

All passed using eleven_v3 in ~110s total.
